statement: A visible retreat from danger alone does not prove inner fear or cowardice, just as outward confrontation alone does not prove wisdom. This is a bounded cross-text inference informed by Milindapañha 5.4.9 and contrasted with Vinaya Pi Tv Kd 17, not a directly attested early-discourse definition.
